# CRM Industry Opportunities

| Opportunity | Why it is attractive | Industry capability requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Export manufacturing revenue operations | High account value, overseas prospecting, RFQs, complex quotes and ERP/finance dependencies reinforce one workflow. | Connect prospecting, quotation, order, shipment and collection data with regional controls. |
| Industrial distribution | Regional, channel and volume pricing create repeatable quotation work and approval needs. | Support account hierarchies, price lists, discount approval and quotation versioning. |
| Cross-border B2B | Teams need multilingual research, outreach, time-zone scheduling and compliant activity capture. | Preserve lead source, lawful basis, language, time zone, activity and handoff context. |
| Mid-sized growth companies | Spreadsheet, messaging and ERP fragmentation creates measurable process gaps. | Prioritise measurable cycle time, follow-up coverage, data completeness and forecast quality. |
| Ecosystem collaboration | ERP integrators, trade-service firms, logistics and industrial associations already reach the customer pool. | Provide interoperable data models, APIs and implementation standards. |
